title: SAML2 connector assistant: automated metadata repair, cert-rotation simulator, and RBAC attestation
creator: Maya Thompson
description: Ship an interactive SAML 2.0 connector assistant that both validates incoming IdP metadata and offers automated, idempotent repair suggestions for common failures. This ticket covers three deliverables: (1) metadata sanity scanner with repair actions and a dry-run mode, (2) a certificate-rotation simulator to let admins rehearse IdP cert rollovers without downtime, and (3) an RBAC attestation prompt that ensures admin approvals are recorded and audit-logged before connector activation. Goal: reduce time-to-onboard for enterprise SSO by surfacing fixes and preventing misconfigurations that later cause outages.
acceptance_criteria: Assistant validates metadata XML and surfaces a non-blocking list of issues categorized by severity (schema errors, missing endpoints, ambiguous entityIDs, broken signatures)
Automated repair actions (entityID normalization, missing ACS insertion hints, clock-skew mitigation) are presented as opt-in previews and can be applied in dry-run and apply modes
Certificate-rotation simulator accepts a rotated cert bundle, simulates assertion flows across stages (pre-rotation, rollover, post-rotation) and reports expected SAML response failure modes
RBAC attestation flow requires an admin with role 'sso-admin' to confirm connector changes; all confirmations are emitted to audit logs with change diffs
All user-facing changes go behind a feature flag and have telemetry events for success/failure, with error reason tagging
implementation_notes: Metadata scanner uses existing XML parser (libxml2 wrapper) and our signature validator; add heuristics module to detect common IdP exporter patterns (Okta, ADFS, AzureAD)
Repair actions are best-effort only; preserve original uploaded artifact and create a change bundle stored in our audit service for rollback
Simulator runs a synthetic AuthnRequest against a test harness that replicates our assertion consumer flow; use local certs and a short-lived test IdP container
RBAC attestation integrates with RBAC v2: only principals in 'sso-admin' or 'security-owner' can finalize a repair apply; write an audit event with user, timestamp, and resulting metadata hash
Metrics: onboarding-success-rate, avg-time-to-activate-connector, simulator-run-failures; log detailed failure codes for triage
test_plan: Unit tests for metadata heuristics with 150+ sample IdP XML files (mix of well-formed, truncated, and deliberately malformed)
End-to-end test: upload metadata -> dry-run repair -> apply repair -> run simulator -> perform real SAML flow against staged IdP
Manual QA: multi-tenant accounts with RBAC v2 policies to verify attestation gating and audit entries
Load test: run concurrent metadata scans (200/s) to ensure scanner scales; measure latency p95 and memory use
Security review: threat model focused on parser DoS, XML external entity (XXE) attacks, and signature skipping bugs
